description: This file defines the 'Each' class, a validation rule within the HRM system that applies a composite rule to each element of an iterable input. It is used for validating collections where each item must satisfy certain criteria.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A validation rule that applies a given composite rule to each element in an iterable input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule to be applied to each element.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all elements in the input satisfy the composite rule; throws or returns false otherwise.
